rows.requirement: Audit semiconductor supply chain and accelerator-vendor sales to establish an accurate record of pre-deal compute production.
rows.gap: Public source snapshots are preserved, but complete production reconciliation is not claimed.

rows.requirement: Trace declared compute sales to physical end-use location, audit large owners recursively, and sample smaller owners.
rows.gap: Public site and aggregate compute evidence exist; transaction-level recursive transfer chains and physical inspections are not yet public.

rows.requirement: Locate remaining unaccounted compute with incentives and aerial imagery.
rows.gap: The repository has an explicit physical-observation worklist and 631 derived observations across 92 of 93 Epoch sites, plus a disclosure protocol. One reference-site physical target remains unresolved and there is no public dataset of verified incentive/disclosure events.

rows.requirement: Starting from verified vendor sales, recursively audit every direct customer above threshold T and continue until unaudited recipients are below T.
rows.gap: The threshold-based audit population and entity-resolution interfaces are implemented; no closed external audit population or realized audit outcome is claimed. track3_audit_chain.py runs the recursive above-T audit on a declared ledger; only a synthetic example exists.

rows.requirement: Add untraceable sales and unverifiable decommissioning to an untraced pool L.
rows.gap: The residual untraced-compute pool and closure rules are implemented; its current value remains UNKNOWN because the transaction chain is not closed. track3_audit_chain.py computes L from a declared ledger (unauditable counterparties, unverified decommissioning, unaccounted units, inspection shortfalls); only a synthetic example exists.

rows.requirement: Complete the account so compute is physically verified, added to L, or delivered to a below-threshold recipient.
rows.gap: Account reconciliation (physically verified, added to L, or delivered to a below-threshold recipient) is implemented in track3_audit_chain.py and exercised on a synthetic closed population; no real transaction ledger is public, so no actual compute is reconciled.

rows.requirement: Randomly sample H100e units from below-threshold deliveries and trace each through resales to physical inspection or failure.
rows.gap: A deterministic sampling and serial-trace protocol is implemented; no realized sample outcome is claimed.

rows.requirement: Sample units from the tail proportional to deliveries and audit the selected recipient's account.
rows.gap: The sampling-frame and reproducibility contract is implemented; population eligibility and realized outcomes remain external.

rows.requirement: Resolve sampled units proportionally between current holdings and onward sales.
rows.gap: The lifecycle/transfer integrity protocol is implemented; no global serial ledger is publicly ingested. track3_audit_chain.py resolves each sampled unit in proportion to held, sold-onward and decommissioned units and follows onward sales to the buyer.

rows.requirement: Classify each sample trace as pass or fail and statistically constrain the undetected tail.
rows.gap: The tail-bound certificate calculator is implemented; no empirical certificate is asserted without a closed population and observed sample outcomes.

rows.requirement: Use minimal-notice inspections and record serial numbers to prevent borrowed-chip audit evasion.
rows.gap: Inspection and serial-capture protocols are implemented; current authorized physical inspection observations remain zero.

rows.requirement: Control post-deal transfers above de minimis and require witnessed destruction or serial-verified recycling.
rows.gap: Post-deal transfer/destruction/recycling verification rules are implemented; no independent enforcement authority or complete public event ledger is claimed.
